assertions.assertion: CPT 93247 is a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is ordered to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and guide further management
The claim is for a 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study
